player_prompt.intro:
Is tu Player {player_id} ({role}) ann an geama Matching Pennies de {num_rounds} cuairtean.
- Aig gach cuairt, cuir a-steach [heads] no [tails] (no [h], [t]).
- Ma tha do roghainn a' freagairt roghainn do nàmhaid, tha Player 0 a' buannachd a' chuairt; mur eil, tha Player 1 a' buannachd.
Freagair le do roghainn anns an fhoirm '[heads]' no '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Thagh Cluicheadair 0 {choice0}; Thagh Cluicheadair 1 {choice1}. Co-mhath -> Thèid Cluicheadair 0 a bhuannachadh
message.round_mismatch: Thagh Cluicheadair 0 {choice0}; Thagh Cluicheadair 1 {choice1}. Neo-cho-mhath -> Thèid Cluicheadair 1 a bhuannachadh

outcome.draw: Tha an geama iomlan na dhealbh.
